This document outlines the major maintenance procedures P1, which must be 
carried out every five years as indicated by Y5 in the title 
block

The pump function is to cool the outlet 
steam from LP turbine to convert the steam to 
condensate water, and also to cool the closed cooling water for accessories

The first draft initiated and tested by eng. Raafat 
Abd Alla, reviewed by eng. Samy Kamal general director, revised 
by eng. 
Abouda Elbana 
EDEPC inspection and quality control 
engineer, and approved by eng. Moukhtar Mady head sector of Ataka PS

This document accepted by eng. Samir Abdel Gilel: 
EDEPC 
inspection and 
quality control
general director and MPIS coordinator, and certified by accountant Mahmoud 
Mohamed Soliman EDEPC admin. & financial inspection, quality control general 
director and supervisor of inspection & quality control's head sector.

A work permit must be issued, the qualified maintenance 
 staff should carry the suitable safety category.
Safety fence with caution marks surrounding work area is required.

Wear your safety equipment as safety helmet, safety shoes, breathing mask, safety glass .. 
 etc.

items:
A work permit must be issued, the qualified maintenance 
 staff should carry the suitable safety category.
Safety fence with caution marks surrounding work area is required.

Wear your safety equipment as safety helmet, safety shoes, breathing mask, safety glass .. 
 etc.
Isolate the circuit breaker of the pump motor.
Disconnect electric terminals of the pump motor.
The pump must be isolated mechanically by closing delivery and suction valves.
Be sure pump must be completely drainage.
Complete maintenance tool set
Cleaning fluid, Manual puller
Feeler gauge, Dial indicator
Vibrometer, Straight edge, Rags
Check the discharge quantity and pump pressure and record it
Check the vibration level of the pump and motor and record them
Remove the feed lines of lubrication water and oil cooling for pump
Dismantle the bolts of the upper carden coupling and lift the motor
Dismantling the carden coupling from pump side
Drain the dearing housing from oil
Dismantle the motor base

Remove 
 the coupling from the pump shaft and it's key

Dismantle the thrust bearing (cover, deflector, rings, brace ring, ball 
 bearing, springs, cooling coil)
Dismantle the bolts between the discharge elbow and discharge line.
Lift the pump and put it in the work place.
Dismantle the suction element.
Check the clearance between suction element and impeller.
Remove the impeller after remove the impeller nose.
Remove the bowl.
Remove the stuffing box gland, lantern ring and gland cover.
Dismantle the discharge elbow.
Dismantle the lower journal bearing.

Check the stuffing box shaft sleeve for wearing 
 and damage

Check the bearing shaft sleeve (when radial 
 clearance is higher than 0.7 mm it must be changed)

Check ing the thrust - bearing box for wearing 
 and damage

Check the clearance between suction element and 
 impeller
Clean the impeller and shaft
Install the upper and lower sleeves
Insert the lower journal bearing
Install the impeller and it's nose
Install the bowl and the discharge elbow
Install the suction element
Install the thrust box with a new gasket and oil sleeve
Install the cooler coil
Install the thrust bed
Install the exterior ring of bearing
Install upper thrust - bearing with its components
Assembly the coupling of pump
Install the rotor into pump

Assembly 
 the cover of the thrust box

Insert the packing rings and lantern ring and gland cover with out working 
 tighten
Put the pump into it's casing
Install the elbow
Assembly the carden coupling pump side and grease it
Assembly the motor base frame
Assembly the carden coupling motor side
Fill the thrust box with oil
Install the attached piping
Attach the temperature gauge in the thrust box
Attach the lines of cooling water for oil and motor
Attach the lines of lubrication water.
Check the direction of rotation of pump.
Check the oil level.
Check the cooling water valve (open) for motor and oil.
Check the lubrication water pump.
Tighten the gland flange for normal leakage.
Check the bearing temp pump.
Check the temp and rate of cooling water for oil and motor.
Check vibration.

Introduction
This document outlines the major maintenance procedures P1, which must be 
carried out every five years as indicated by Y5 in the title 
block
The pump function is to cool the outlet 
steam from LP turbine to convert the steam to 
condensate water, and also to cool the closed cooling water for accessories

Safety Precautions
A work permit must be issued, the qualified maintenance 
 staff should carry the suitable safety category.
Safety fence with caution marks surrounding work area is required.
Wear your safety equipment as safety helmet, safety shoes, breathing mask, safety glass ..
